title: I Believe #11 - Repent and Believe | The Apostles' Creed
description: Pastor Daniel delves into the spiritual warfare surrounding believers, emphasizing the need for vigilance and reliance on prayer and the Word of God. He recounts a recent experience underscoring the reality of this spiritual battle, highlighting the importance of staying alert and walking with Jesus in the power of the Holy Spirit. Key takeaways include the recognition that the enemy has no power over Jesus and that responding in fleshly ways leads to detrimental outcomes. Quoting passages like 2 Timothy 1:7-8 and 1 Peter 5:8-11, the message emphasizes the necessity of resisting the devil, standing firm in faith, and relying on the Holy Spirit for victory. Moreover, the concept of salvation as a multifaceted journey encompassing past forgiveness through Christ, present sanctification, and future redemption. Through passages like Philippians 2:12-13 and Romans 5:9-10, it stresses the ongoing process of being saved and the ultimate hope of salvation's fulfillment in the return of Jesus. The call to repentance, belief in the gospel, and reliance on God's grace is reiterated, along with the admonition to reject the world's darkness and embrace the light of Christ. Pastor Daniel concludes with a reminder of the ongoing spiritual battle, the journey of salvation, and the importance of communal faith and perseverance in the Christian walk.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: I Believe #10 -  Church is Essential | The Apostles' Creed
description: Pastor Daniel emphasizes the essential role of the church within Christian doctrine, challenging the notion of a "churchless Christianity" as a contradiction, likening it to Christ without a body. Drawing from the Creed, he highlights the church's significance, not as a mere physical location, but as a collective body of believers. Despite differences among denominations, the sermon emphasizes the unity of the church as one body, underscored by biblical references such as Ephesians 4:4-6. It addresses misconceptions regarding the term "catholic," affirming its universal relevance rather than sectarian affiliation. Furthermore, it delves into the church's holiness, rooted in Christ's sanctification rather than human perfectionism, and underscores believers' identity as saints consecrated by God. Moreover, the message stresses the importance of community within the church, viewing believers as part of a vast network spanning time and space, united in faith and purpose. It encourages believers to find strength and support within this community, especially amidst challenges and opposition in the secular world. Ultimately, the sermon calls for a profound appreciation of the church's significance beyond personal fulfillment, recognizing it as a divine institution instrumental in advancing God's purposes and fostering spiritual growth and unity among believers.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: I Believe #9 - Believing Is Receiving | The Apostles' Creed
description: The sermon, delivered by Pastor Daniel, challenges prevailing notions of cultural differences, suggesting a nuanced understanding beyond mere independence and interdependence. It reflects on Western culture's emphasis on self-expression and societal shifts over time. Drawing from personal experiences as an Uber driver, Pastor Daniel notes the prevalence of self-expression and its implications for societal norms. Transitioning to a biblical perspective, the sermon centers on Proverbs 6's teachings on correction and instruction. Pastor Daniel contrasts societal values with the enduring truths found in God's word, warning against prioritizing self-expression over heeding divine guidance. Emphasis is placed on the Holy Spirit's role in guiding believers, correcting them, and empowering them to live according to God's will amidst shifting cultural values. In conclusion, Pastor Daniel calls for a reaffirmation of faith in the Holy Spirit and a commitment to living out one's beliefs in a world where cultural norms may change but God's truth remains constant. He urges believers to anchor themselves in God's unchanging wisdom and to seek His guidance in navigating the complexities of modern life, finding value in humility, obedience, and reliance on the Holy Spirit.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: I Believe #8 - The End Of The World | The Apostles' Creed
description: Jesus is coming to judge the living and the dead. The sermon centers on Parousia, the second coming of Jesus, emphasizing the belief in his return for heavenly justice. It cites John 5:25-29 and highlights Jesus' authority as the Son of Man to judge the living and the dead. The Apostles' Creed and the metaphor of a wedding feast symbolize the end of the world and divine intimacy. Challenges related to end times interpretations are discussed, emphasizing the unique Christian story. The need for spiritual rebirth is stressed using John 3:3-18, and the first and second comings of Jesus are contrasted. The Lausanne Covenant underscores the significance of Jesus' return in Christian faith. The sermon concludes with practical implications, urging believers to evangelize, endure trials, and encourage one another. Communion is presented as a symbolic reminder of the anticipated feast upon the Lord's return.

title: I Believe # 7 - Christ Centered Perspective | The Apostles' Creed
description: The sermon focuses on the Christ-Centered Perspective provided specifically the statement of the Apostles' Creed - "He ascended into heaven and is seated at the right hand of the Father." Pastor Daniel emphasizes the importance of perspective in shaping beliefs and actions, highlighting the danger of having a limited or misguided viewpoint. The ascension of Jesus is discussed, acknowledging that it may have initially left the disciples feeling abandoned. However, the Christ-centered perspective assures believers that Jesus will never abandon them and has empowered them with the Holy Spirit. The application of this promise is emphasized, especially in times of life's challenges, grief, or failure. The sermon contrasts the temporary nature of this world with the eternal promise of a Christ-centered perspective. Believers are encouraged to find purpose, value, and fulfillment in the Lord rather than seeking them from the world. The tension of being committed to serving the world while recognizing it is not the ultimate home is explored. The message concludes by highlighting the hope Christians have in bringing peace, hope, and love into their lives and the lives of others, all empowered by the Holy Spirit. The supreme authority of Jesus, seated at the right hand of God, is emphasized as a source of hope, reminding believers of their eternal victory over sin and death. The importance of maintaining a Christ-centered perspective, focusing on the things above, is stressed as believers navigate the challenges of life. The sermon ends with an encouragement to look up to Jesus, who intercedes for believers and empowers them to live with a perspective that acknowledges Jesus as King.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: I Believe #6 - All Fear Is Gone | The Apostles' Creed
description: The sermon, delivered by Pastor Daniel, delves into the theme of overcoming fear and the significance of Jesus' descent to the dead and resurrection. Fear often hinders personal growth, and Pastor Daniel emphasizes that conquering it allows for a more authentic and satisfying life. He highlights that conquering fear doesn't mean all problems are solved, but it eradicates inner turmoil. Pastor Daniel then transitions to a discussion of the creeds, focusing on the phrase "He descended to the dead" from the Apostle's Creed. He clarifies the meaning, emphasizing Jesus' genuine death and descent into Hades, not Gehenna. The significance lies in Jesus going ahead of believers, providing assurance in facing death without fear of solitude. Addressing potential objections, Pastor Daniel refutes the swoon theory, emphasizing the physical death and resurrection of Jesus. The narrative from Matthew 27:32-28:10 is presented to highlight the crucifixion, death, and resurrection of Jesus. The conclusion, presented by Pastor Daniel, connects the Easter story to Ephesians 2:1-7 and 1 Corinthians 15:42-55, emphasizing the forgiveness of sins through Christ's sacrifice and the hope of resurrection. Pastor Daniel concludes with a powerful statement about the knowledge that all sins were in the future when Jesus died on the cross, highlighting God's unconditional love and sacrifice for humanity.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Does God Care About Suffering? - I Believe #5 | The Apostles' Creed
description: In this powerful sermon titled "Why Does God Allow Suffering?" Pastor Daniel delves into the profound question that has puzzled humanity for ages. The sermon begins by acknowledging the historical atrocities of the 20th century, particularly during World War 1 and the Holocaust, leading to the emergence of Protest Atheism—a movement that protested against a seemingly indifferent God in the face of immense human suffering. The sermon centers around an exploration of the Apostles' Creed, focusing on the section that states, "(Jesus) suffered under Pontius Pilate, was crucified, died, and was buried." Pastor Daniel provides historical context, emphasizing that Jesus' suffering was not a mere story but a specific event anchored in real historical time. The crucifixion of Jesus is described as the most barbaric moment in history, emphasizing its historical and spiritual significance. The narrative highlights Jesus' choice to lay down his life for the sins of the world, showcasing God's deliberate engagement with human history. Pontius Pilate's role is underscored as representative of the world's rejection of Jesus, implicating humanity as a whole in the crucifixion. The gruesome details of Jesus' crucifixion are vividly portrayed, drawing parallels to contemporary Roman practices. The sermon contrasts the public's reaction to Jesus' crucifixion with modern events, using the example of Osama Bin Laden's death to illustrate the shame associated with crucifixion. The sermon further explores the meaning of Jesus' death, emphasizing its purpose in paying for humanity's sins. The burial of Jesus is recounted, providing certainty of his death, and Pastor Daniel concludes by linking the suffering of Jesus to the broader concept of salvation. In a final statement, Pastor Daniel asserts belief in Jesus Christ as the one who endured the most barbaric moment in history, bringing salvation to the world. The audience is encouraged to reflect on their relationship with Jesus, posing the question of whether he is their Lord and expressing the transformative power of Jesus' sacrifice. The sermon leaves the congregation with a sense of awe and gratitude for the profound act of salvation accomplished through Jesus' suffering.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: I Believe #4 - Only Jesus Can Save | The Apostles' Creed
description: In this week's sermon, Pastor Daniel uses the metaphor of a vast and turbulent ocean to depict the challenges, sins, and difficulties of life, with Jesus being the unwavering lifeboat symbolizing salvation, forgiveness, and eternal life. The focus shifts to the historical context of the Apostles' Creed, emphasizing its role in summarizing essential truths contributed by each Apostle. Pastor Daniel delves into the significance of Jesus being both fully divine and fully human, drawing on biblical passages such as Matthew 1:18-25 and Galatians 4:4. The dual nature of Jesus is portrayed as crucial for understanding and achieving redemption. The sermon further explores the idea that Jesus, as both God and human, serves as a mediator, understanding and healing humanity. The power over sin through faith in Jesus is emphasized, encouraging believers to walk by the Spirit and love their neighbors, recognizing their freedom from sin. Pastor Daniel concludes by urging listeners to reject doubts, embrace God's truth, and submit to the Holy Spirit, emphasizing the unique and exclusive role of Jesus in salvation.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: I Believe #3 -  I Believe in Jesus |  The Apostles' Creed
description: Jesus alone has the power to bring healing to a hostile world. This week we look at the words of the Apostles' Creed which read, "I believe in Jesus Christ, his only Son, our Lord." From this short sentence, we are able to see that Jesus is the Messiah, he is God, and he is in the place of authority as Lord. These are distinct beliefs of the Christian faith and help us understand with clarity who Jesus is. We encourage you to memorize the Apostles' Creed in order to help strengthen your faith and always have an answer to others in what you believe.

title: I Believe #2 - I Believe in God | The Apostles' Creed
description: The first four words of The Apostles' Creed immediately forge a wedge between our confession of faith in God and the world's denial of God's existence. "I Believe" is a statement of trusting in God, placing your confidence in, and allegiance to, God. God is the source of all life, he is powerful and personal, and he is sovereign over all creation. We see all of this in this week's section of the creed which reads, "I believe in God, the Father almighty, Creator of heaven and earth." We encourage you to memorize the creed and make it part of your devotional life. You'll be well-rounded in your faith and always be ready to share with others what you believe in.

title: I Believe #1 - Believing Changes Us | The Apostles' Creed
description: When Jesus said "Repent and believe in the gospel," he meant for that belief to be more than simply agreeing with the truth. The word believe means to place confidence in, or trust in, the good news. This new series leads us to explore The Apostles' Creed for a few weeks in order to build out a rounded, grounded faith in Jesus as Lord. Today's message reminds us that believing in Jesus changes us. We are changed as we come into agreement with God and other followers, trust Jesus as Lord, commit to Jesus fully, and walk in obedience to him. Join us as we learn this creed and use it to draw closer to Jesus. Below is the creed we are using. THE APOSTLES' CREED I believe in God, the Father almighty, creator of heaven and earth. I believe in Jesus Christ, his only Son, our Lord, who was conceived by the Holy Spirit, born of the Virgin Mary, suffered under Pontius Pilate, was crucified, died, and was buried; he descended to the dead. On the third day he rose again; he ascended into heaven, he is seated at the right hand of the Father, and he will come to judge the living and the dead. I believe in the Holy Spirit, the holy *catholic Church, the communion of saints, the forgiveness of sins, the resurrection of the body, and the life everlasting. Amen.

title: Advent 2023 --  Unexpected Joy
description: Jesus brings joy in unexpected times and unexpected ways. Hold on to Jesus as Lord and Savior and you will have and enduring joy no matter life's circumstances.

title: Advent 2023 --  Peace Isn't Enough
description: We all long for peace in our relationship and in the world. The world cannot offer enduring peace, only Jesus can do that. Jesus didn't just bring us peace... he is peace himself. Christmas is the season where Jesus brings peace to the world. Will you receive his peace?

title: Advent 2023 --  Hope Isn't Enough
description: Hope by itself is not enough. The quality of your hope is contingent on what your hope is tethered to... Christmas is the season that Jesus is the only one worth having hope in.

title: Purpose -- Connecting People to Others | Part 2
description: What is my role in helping others connect in healthy relationships? What is the best thing I can do? Here's a clue... it starts with allowing yourself to be transformed by the presence of God.

title: Purpose -- Connecting People to One Another || Pastor Daniel
description: Do you want to have healthy relationships in your family, friends, and work circles? Jesus is the key to connecting to others in a way that builds relationships instead of destroying them. Today's sermon gives us directives on how to build healthy, God-honoring relationships.

title: Purpose -- Connecting Others to Jesus || Pastor Daniel
description: Connecting other people to Jesus can be exhilarating or terrifying! Most of the time it is somewhere in between. What are effective ways to help others connect with Jesus, and what is my motivation for sharing the good news of Jesus! May this message encourage you to fulfill one of the church's purposes -- connecting others to Jesus.

title: Purpose -- Connecting Ourselves to Jesus || Pastor Austin
description: Pastor Austin starts our sermon series on our purpose, which is "connecting people to Jesus and one another." This first sermon emphasizes the necessity for us to be connected to Jesus and maintaining a healthy relationship with the Lord.

title: Offensive Faith -- Standing Up To Bullies
description: Demons are bullies using fear to intimidate God's people. In the name of Jesus, we are to stand up to these bullies and win every battle. Jesus gives us this power as members of his body. No longer live in fear or defeat, because Jesus is glorified when we walk in faith and victory.

title: Offensive Faith -- No Longer A Victim
description: It is disobedience to God to live with a victim mindset when Jesus has guaranteed us the victory. Choose today to no longer live as a victim, but live as a victor.

title: Offensive Faith -- Know Your Enemy
description: Every battle we face is not supernatural. There are three enemies with which we must contend: the world, the flesh, and the devil. As you raise your shield of faith, it is important to know your enemy.

title: Offensive Faith -- No Running
description: When facing Satan and his demonic hosts, we are not to run from the battle. Jesus gives us the power and authority to stand firm in the faith and win every spiritual battle. Ephesians 6:13; James 4:7, & 1 Peter 5:8-9

title: Offensive Faith -- Exercising the Authority of Jesus
description: Jesus has delegated all believers with his authority over Satan and his demonic hosts. Jesus said, "I have given you authority to trample on snakes and scorpions and to overcome all the power of the enemy; nothing will harm you." Luke 10:19

title: Offensive Faith -- Spiritual Warfare & Supernatural Weapons
description: Spiritual warfare is often unseen and requires us to fight with supernatural weapons. Satan is a real enemy, but Jesus gives us all we need to stand up to his attacks. Incorporating God's divine power ensures victory in our spiritual battles.

title: Offensive Faith -- What Is Your Motivation?
description: What motivates you in life? What is the ultimate motivation in life? Living for God to be glorified in every area of your life is the ultimate way to always have something motivating you. We bring God glory when we implore him for help, give him all the credit, and pray offensively for our oppressors to be put to shame. This week is the second sermon in our series called, "Offensive Faith."

title: Offensive Faith -- Lies That Bind
description: There are lies will bind you to defeat if you believe. Replace these common lies with the truth of God's word and his promises. This sermon series focuses on an offensive, not defensive, faith. Join us as we learn together how to live in victory.

title: Following Jesus
description: If there's one thing to focus on as a Christian, it is following Jesus. There are many things debatable in the Christian faith, but this one is not. Today's message encourages people to follow Jesus. Keep it simple. Look to Jesus and follow him.

title: Serve One Another
description: We are freed by Jesus in order to help others through serving. We are only able to do this because of what Jesus has done for us. Galatians 5:13-15 and John 13:12-17 are the key passages of today's sermon.

title: Breath Of God
description: The Spirit of God is life-giving, life-transforming, and life-renewing. Adam was created and given life by the breath of God. Ezekiel 37 gives us the transforming work of the Spirit, and Jesus breathed on the disciples telling them to receive the Spirit. God has instilled his breath in us and comforts us with his very presence.

title: God is still moving
description: God is moving because of his love to act in ways to fulfill his purposes. John 3:16 reminds us at all time that God moved and is still moving. God looks at us in our helpless estate and moves to bring us salvation and victory.

title: Defining Moments
description: Some moments in life define you. The day you were born, moving, marriage, losing a loved one, or having a child are just a few. Moses had a defining moment with a burning shrub in the desert. Seeing a bush on fire was common, but what was uncommon was that it refused to disintegrate like a normal bush would. God got Moses' attention that day. What does God have to do to get your attention today? God will give you defining moments in his place, for his people, for his purposes, according to his plan. The ultimate defining moment is what Jesus did for the world by sacrificing his own life so we could have life eternal.

title: The Gracious and Good God
description: The gracious and good God is known through Jesus Christ. This sermon shows us how Jesus comes to us, is our salvation, and he is also our rest. We enter God's rest to rest from our own work.

description: If you think 2020 has been rough, then you're exactly right. In some ways this year is unprecedented. But one thing we can count on is that God is awakening our world to the sins that have been hiding under the surface. It's not just the sin "out there" in the world, but it is also the sin hiding in the dark crevices of our hearts. Pastor Daniel talks about finding joy in the midst of the pandemic, economic crash, and heightened awareness of racial injustices. Where do you look for joy? title: Listening to Our Lord Jesus in Prayer | Living Out My Purpose
description: Listening to Our Lord Jesus in Prayer | Living Out My Purpose There's no point in learning about God if you're not going to put what you learn into action. Faith in Jesus isn't a school project where you learn facts, take a test, and get a grade. Faith is action. Faith is personal. Faith is obedience to God's commands to (1) love God with all your heart, soul, mind, and strength, and to (2) love your neighbor as yourself! Angela and Pastor Daniel discuss racial biases and tensions, and also what #saymyname means. As a church, we must live out our faith in a broken world in a way that acknowledges the brokenness AND leads people to trust in the promises of God that say reconciliation is on its way. Pastor Daniel encourages us to take 10 minutes each day this week to be silent with God... to be alone with him and let him be the sole focus of our attention. With so many voices speaking in the world, it is imperative for the followers of Jesus to designate the voice of God as the primary one we are listening to. Prayer is not confined to us talking to God, but God reveals himself to us through prayer, Scripture, and the Spirit of God.

It encourages fellow Christians to hear it, and it gives non-Christians a story to help them understand the good news (gospel) of Jesus and how they can also trust him as Lord. Many people feel like their testimony is not as good as others, but each testimony is different, powerful, personal, and miraculous. Today's sermon shares 3 truths for all people regarding our need for Jesus, and we also hear from 3 different people as they share the story of how they came to faith in Jesus. Connection Church is starting a new sermon series called, "Living Out My Purpose." Our purpose statement is "Connection People to Jesus and One Another." For 8 weeks we are going to focus on how we can live this out in our lives. We hope today encourages you to be ready to share your testimony!

title: Hebrews: Jesus Is Better - Jesus is the Better Voice (Hebrews 3:7-19)
description: The voice of Jesus is always calling us into rest with the Father. Silencing the other voices in our lives is not something we can or should do alone. Let us learn to distinguish the voice of Jesus and make use of the community he has placed us in to experience freedom.

title: Hebrews: Jesus Is Better - Jesus Is The Better Rescuer (Hebrews 3:1-6)
description: Moses rescued God's people from slavery, but Jesus rescued God's people from slavery in a way they will never be enslaved again! Jesus is better!

title: Hebrews: Jesus Is Better - Jesus Is the Better Mediator (Hebrews 2:17-18)
description: When there is no peace, reconciliation is needed and nobody is better than Jesus at this!

title: Hebrews: Jesus Is Better - Jesus Is The Better Liberator (Hebrews 2:11-16)
description: Jesus frees us from the fear of death by unifying us to himself.

title: Hebrews: Jesus Is Better - Jesus is the Better Pioneer (Hebrews 2:10)
description: As the better Pioneer, Jesus blazes a trail for his followers. When we remain in him we discover abundant life.

title: Hebrews:Jesus Is Better - Jesus Determines Our Destiny (Hebrews 2:5-9)
description: Our destiny is directly tied to what we believe about Jesus.

title: Hebrews:Jesus Is Better - Salvation Through Jesus Is Better (Hebrews 2:1-4)
description: Every person seeks salvation in some way, shape, or form but no other way truly rescues us like Jesus.

title: Hebrews: Jesus Is Better - Jesus Is Superior To Angels (Hebrews 1:4-14)
description: People are in awe of angels and spiritual beings, but as majestic as these beings are they bow down and worship Jesus as Lord! Remember that we rise up when we seek Jesus and bow down to him as Lord!

title: Hebrews: Jesus Is Better - The Superiority Of Jesus (Hebrews 1:1-3)
description: Hebrews 1:1-3 On this first Sunday of 2019, set the bar higher for your view of Jesus. He is far superior to anything you have ever imagined!

title: O Come Let Us Adore Him: Jesus Died and Rose Again - 1 Thessalonians 4:14
description: Why is the early Christian creed, "Jesus died and rose again," such a powerful truth? Packed into this short creed is a limitless wealth of hope, strength, wisdom, and more!

title: O Come Let Us Adore Him: Unto Us A Child Is Born - Luke 2:1-20
description: God is always working through the good and bad in the world to fulfill his promises, and because of this He is leading us to worship him.

title: O Come Let Us Adore Him: God Is Calling You
description: Too often we expect God to deliver the extraordinary when we didn’t invest faithfulness in the mundane. Luke 1:57-80

title: O Come Let Us Adore Him:Mary's Favored Christmas
description: Luke 1:26-45 -- Mary was favored because of God's grace and her faith. You and I can experience that same favor through the same means. What will your Christmas be like this year?

title: O Come Let Us Adore Him:Breaking The Silence - Luke 1:1-25
description: 400 years of silence separated the last activity of the Old Testament and the fulfillment of Malachi's prophecy about Jesus. How do we live our lives when we feel God is silent?

title: The Way Forward:Moving Forward - Exodus 40
description: The way forward is living as the people of God. God has redeemed us as his people, set us apart for his purposes, and called us to live in active faith in him. God's purpose is to move us forward.

title: The Way Forward:Glory Reflected - Exodus 34
The Way Forward:Wanting More - Exodus 33
description: The blessings from God are truly enjoyed when they are accompanied with the presence of God in our lives. Don't settle for less than God's best.

title: The Way Forward:Forgotten Faithfulness - Exodus 32
description: When waiting is not working, then it is time to start worshiping God. It may seem like God is taking too long, but he is always on time... his good and perfect time.

title: The Way Forward:Path To His Presence: Exodus 27-30
description: There is a tension in experiencing God’s presence; God’s holiness versus our sinfulness. Jesus removes that tension through the cross.

title: The Way Forward:God Comes Near - Exodus 25-26
description: The promise behind the instructions of the Tabernacle is the promise of God's presence. God is with his people and comes near to them to share his heart.

title: The Way Forward: The Path To Life - Exodus 20
description: The 10 Commandments are not just laws, but they reveal to us God's path to life.

title: The Way Forward:The Power Of God - Exodus 11-12
description: The God who led Israel out of Egypt is the same God who can lead you and me out of our own Egypt if we are willing to follow his lead.

title: The Way Forward: The Battle For The Heart - Exodus 5-10
description: We are either going into, coming out of, or in the middle of a battle. We must guard our hearts against the temptation to doubt God during these times, and remember the promises of God. Through our relationship with Jesus, we will win the battle of the heart.

title: The Way Forward: Defining Moments - Exodus 3-4
description: Every day if filled with defining moments. Some of these moments are high or low, planned or unplanned, and big or small. But all of them lead us to make choices that will determine whether we stay stuck or move forward!

title: Exodus:The Way Forward:Doing It My Way - Exodus 2
The Way Forward:Doing It My Way - Exodus 2
description: We are prone to try and fix things ourselves, but when we are stuck God desires to move us forward in our lives. However, it has to be His way and not ours. Exodus 2 shows us the difference between doing it my way or God's way.

title: Exodus: The Way Forward: Getting Stuck - Exodus 1
The Way Forward: Getting Stuck - Exodus 1
description: What do you do when you are stuck and there seems to be no way out? Will you retaliate and take matters into your own hands, or will you resist that temptation and turn to the Lord for your help? Your choice will determine how long you are "stuck."

title: Psalms Of Summer: Psalm 131- Living Content
description: Life easily becomes about what we can get -- next! Our length of satisfaction with products, games, and even our homes seems to have gotten shorter than ever. The secret to living a peace-filled life is learning how to be content no matter what circumstances we have. Psalm 131 helps us take that step

title: Psalms Of Summer: Psalm 130 - Out Of The Depths
description: Psalms 130 talks about God taking you deeper in your walk with himMessage is preached by guest speaker David Ellis.

title: Psalms Of Summer: Psalm 121 - The Lord Is My Helper
description: The knowledge that the Lord is our helper in our time of trouble will change everything about our lives. We will never feel alone or helpless when the Almighty Creator is working on our behalf. Psalm 121 is a powerful reminder of the Lord's tireless protection for his children.

title: Message from Vacation Bible School
description: Message from Vacation Bible School finale. Kids participated in vacation bible school all week learning about God in various activities.Great God Great SinGreat LoveGreat JoyScripture is from 2 Peter 1:3

title: Psalms Of Summer: Psalm 83 - Be Angry And Do Not Sin
Psalms Of Summer: Be Angry And Do Not Sin Psalm 83
description: We are created by God as emotional beings. When something is wrong then we rightfully feel angry about it. God doesn't tell us to deny our emotions, but he says to angry and do not sin. Through the lens of the Gospel, Psalm 83 helps us live out this challenging command.

title: Psalms Of Summer: There Is Always A Reason To Sing
description: "PSALMS OF SUMMER (new series) There Is Always A Reason To Sing Psalm 33 Tonight we begin a new series on the psalms called Psalms (songs) of Summer. Pastor Daniel shares how the life Jesus gives us always outlasts the losses we experience. Because Jesus has turned weeping into dancing, we always have a reason to sing with joy!"
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Stranger Beings - God Is For You
description: Pastor Larry shows us from 1 Peter that throughout the good and bad in life, we can remember God is for us and has restoration in mind.Scripture Reading:1 Peter 5:8-11

title: Stranger Beings - Freedom From Anxiety
description: Remind yourself of these three things and memorize these verses, and you will take your next step to be free from anxiety.Scripture reading:1 Peter 5:6-7

title: Stranger Beings - Hows Is My Heart?
description: Our hearts can easily be swayed by the alluring temptations of the world. Tonight's sermon will give you three questions to consider to see if your heart is free from corruption.Scripture Reading: 1 Peter 5:1-5

title: Stranger Beings - See Suffering Differently
description: Suffering is certainly something we don't desire to experience. However, when we see how there is purpose behind our suffering, then it changes how we endure it for the better!Scripture Reading: 1 Peter 4:12-19

title: Stranger Beings - 7 Steps To Make the Most Of Everyday
description: Until you understand that every day truly matters, you will not make the most of your days. Here are 7 steps to help you take advantage of the opportunities God gives you to make the most of every day. Scripture reading: 1 Peter 4:7-12

title: Stranger Beings: Enough Is Enough
description: Sin has caused great harm to the human race, and all of our lives are scarred by the effects of sin. But through his death, burial, and resurrection Jesus has said, "Enough is Enough." He has given us victory over our greatest enemy, and it is time for us to declare his victory over our lives and say with him, "Enough is Enough."Scripture reading: 1 Peter 4:1-6

title: Stranger Beings - From My Hand to God's
description: It is tempting to live life by your own power and ability, but sooner or later you will realize the limitations of your strength. Pastor Daniel teaches how we are to release our burdens of life from our limited grip into the all-powerful hand of God!Scripture Reading: 1 Peter 3:17-22
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Stranger Beings - Everyone Has A Story - What's Yours?
description: Everyone Has A Story - What's Yours? 1 Peter 3:13-16 Peter tells the Christians to be prepared to share the reason why they have hope in a hopeless world. This will be a chance to tell the story of Jesus and the new life they have in him. No matter who you are - you have a story to tell. The question you have to answer is: What's your story?

title: Stranger Beings - Bless And See Good Days
description: The call to Christlikeness is accompanied by the promises of blessing and a listening God. When we choose to bless others, God will choose to bless us both now and forever.Scripture Reading: 1 Peter 3:8-12

title: Stranger Beings: Husband - A Name of Strength and Love
description: When done right, marriage is a powerful display of God's love in our world. The commitment, love, passion, and sacrifice within this relationship is like no other among people. Being a husband that honors the Lord takes faith and great strength, and it causes him to emulate the love of Jesus.Scripture Reading: 1 Peter 3:7 and Ephesians 5:25-33

title: Stranger Beings - Wife: A Name of Strength and Beauty
description: When done right, marriage is a powerful display of God's love in our world. The commitment, love, passion, and sacrifice within this relationship is like no other relationship among people. Being a wife that honors the Lord takes faith and great strength, and it causes her to be the epitome of beauty.Scripture Reading: 1 Peter 3:1-6

title: Stranger Beings - Look At What Jesus Did
description: Scripture Reading: 1 Peter 2:21-25Focusing on what we have done can lead us to the extreme of feeling arrogant because we feel superior to others, or the other other extreme of feeling despondent because we feel we can never measure up. Easter reminds us to turn our eyes away from our own lives and set our eyes on Jesus and marvel at what he has done!

title: Stranger Beings: How Suffering Leads to Justice
description: When experiencing injustice in the world or in the workplace, God has a way for us to find favor from him that leads to justice and healing. The problem with his way is that it may not be the answer we want. Let's look at 1 Peter 2:18-21 and see how justice, favor and submission work together in God's plan.Scripture Reading: 1 Peter 2:18-21

title: Stranger Beings: You Are Free!
description: The freedom we have been given in Christ enables us to give of ourselves in ways that are bold and seen as careless by many. However, as we die to ourselves daily we find abundant life that is good for everyone around us in Christ Jesus.Scripture reading: 1 Peter 2:13-17

title: Stranger Beings: Living Above The Law
description: Sometimes people think the rules don’t apply to them, so they do whatever they want to do. It is said they think they are “above the law.” As a Christian we acknowledge a higher authority than the law of our land — God. This means we go above and beyond the laws of the land because of our faith in Christ. ‘Living above the law’ as a Christian means we observe and honor the laws of our land, and we strive to be exemplary in all our behavior. Our behavior can show a better way to be “living above the law.”Scripture reading: 1 Peter 2:11-12

title: Stranger Beings: Chosen For Excellence
description: Do you ever wonder if your life is making a difference? Do you ever wonder if you bring value to the world? Maybe you know you bring value and make a difference, but you continually try to prove yourself to others. There is rest and assurance when we grasp the truth that God will make a difference in the world through us and be the power within us to accomplish this task. Pastor Daniel encourages us that now is the time to step out in faith and believe God does great work through his people. You are not normal; you are chosen by God for excellence.Scripture Reading: 1 Peter 2:9-10
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Stranger Beings: Stop Building Yourself Up
description: While believing positive things about yourself can improve your circumstances — believing God’s promises for your life will yield strength, peace, and security for your life now and forever. It’s time to stop building yourself up and surrender yourself to the Lord and allow him to build you up more than you ever thought possible.Scripture Reading: 1 Peter 2:4-8

title: Stranger Beings: Simplify Your Life
description: In order to grow up into our salvation, we must long for the purity of the goodness of the LORD.Scripture Reading: 1 Peter2: 1-3

title: Stranger Beings: You Were Born For This
description: We can search our whole lives trying to discover what we were born to do and never find it. Tonight we will see a few things we were born to do, and we will see how to fulfill our destiny in life.

title: Stranger Beings: Fear For My Life
description: What role does "fear" play in your life? In this sermon we learn how to live in a healthy relationship with fear for the rest of our lives on earth. Fear isn't something to be afraid of, but when used properly it can lead us to a life of victory and peace!Scripture Reading is from 1 Peter 1:17-21

title: Stranger Beings: Gird Your Mind, Guard Your Heart
description: Pastor Larry continues our series with a sermon reminding us to prepare our minds for the Christian walk. Scripture Reading: 1 Peter 1:13-16

title: Stranger Beings: I'm Not Over It!
description: We have a great salvation through Christ, yet we can go days without appreciating it. There are many things in life we should "get over", but what Jesus has done for us is not one of them, Today's message will inspire us to wake up every morning acknowledging the Lord and telling him, I'm NOT over it!.Scripture reading is from 1 Peter 1:10-12

title: Stranger Beings: Christian Suffering
description: Guest Speaker David Ellis teaches on how Suffering in this life is different because of Jesus.Scripture Reading is from 1 Peter 1:3-9

title: Stranger Beings: Choose To Be Different
description: As we start our new series we see that God hasn’t called his children to be the same as everyone else. They are called to be different. Pastor Daniel preaches on how we are called to live as Stranger Beings.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Christmas at Connection: Make The Most Of Every Moment
description: When the new year comes we may endeavor to make the next year the best it can be, but maybe that’s not the best goal. Instead of looking at an entire year, realize that every moment is our opportunity to make the most of the life God has given us. This encouraging message will strengthen you to make the most of this moment which is the only moment you’ll ever be in.

title: Christmas at Connection: Hope Unveiled
description: Here how the story of Jesus' mother reminds us all that hope is unveiled in Jesus.

title: Christmas at Connection: Peace Unveiled
description: Peace is not an elusive concept but something we can all have this Christmas. Through Jesus peace is unveiled and available to all who will believe. Join us for our 3rd sermon in our series called Christmas as Connection Church.Scripture reading is from: Micah 5:1-5

title: Christmas at Connection - The Blessing Unveiled
description: God wants to bless you this Christmas in ways you may not expect and in a greater magnitude than you may expect. Pastor Daniel encourages us with a message from the Bible that leads us to expect more this Christmas by living under the powerful blessing of God.The Scripture reading is from: Genesis 12:1-3
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Christmas at Connection - Jesus Unveiled
description: Pastor Larry talks about Jesus as the unveiled Messiah and hope of our world.Scripture reading is from Isaiah 9:4-8.

title: The Power of Thank You
description: Pastor Daniel teaches four blessings we receive that we can thank God for every day no matter what circumstances we go through. Thanksgiving isn’t just for one day; it’s every day.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Dreamer: A Life Well Lived
description: Pastor Daniel concludes the Dreamer series. Jospeh lived a life full with God by his side. What legacy your life will show when you pass away?The Scripture reading is from Genesis 50
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Dreamer: Knowing God In Our Work
description: In this sermon of our sermon series: Dreamer, Pastor Daniel talks about how God can be glorified even in our work and vocations. God wants us to glorify him npc matter what and make an impact with the Gospel among people around us. The Scripture is from Genesis 47:13-26.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Dreamer: Restoration With People
description: Following last week sermon of Restoration with God, Pastor Larry shows us how Biblical follow up is restoration with people. Scripture is from Genesis 46

title: Dreamer: Restoration With God
description: Pastor Daniel continues our sermon series Dreamer on the life of Joseph. Joseph confronts his brothers and Joesph's father wants to see him. Its a great picture of the relationship God wants to have with us in restoring the relationship with himself.Te Scripture reading is from Genesis 45:16 - 28.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Dreamer: Divine Perspective
description: In this sermon, Pastor Daniel talks about having a Divine Perspective. Joseph had a different perspective and recognized God is in control even in difficult circumstances. God views us as his children and loves us that he even sent his only son for us to be sons and daughters in his kingdom.The Scripture reading is from Genesis 45:1-15
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Dreamer: Getting Unstuck
description: In this Sermon, Pastor Daniel continues to talk about the story of Joseph from our Dreamer sermon series. Jospeh's brothers are felt stuck when they go to Egypt to buy food from the famine, but Jospeh gives them compassion. What keeps you stuck when facing trials?
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Dreamer: Let God Guide Your Success
description: Pastor Larry continues our Dreamer sermon series. Jospeh was given great success by God for his faithfulness. God gives us success when we are faithful to him.

title: Dreamer - Forgotten and Disappointed
description: This week Daniel continue the sermon series about the life of Josep. Even though we face trials or hardship, God brings purpose to them to bring himself glory and we are to praise him in the good and the bad times. The Scripture text is from Genesis 40.

title: Dreamer: No Good Deed Goes Unpunished
description: Pastor Larry continues our sermon series "Dreamer" where Jospeh is put through temptation and his decision to fight it is trumped by his status.

title: Dreamer: God at Work - When our plans fall apart
description: Pastor Daniel begins a new sermon series called 'dreamer'. In this sermon he talks about the story of Joseph and his brothers and how Joesphs plans could have been thought to be falling apart but ultimately God had bigger plans for Joseph.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Dreamer: God at Work - When Your Dreams Fall Apart
description: Pastor Daniel begins a new sermon series called 'dreamer'. In this sermon he talks about the story of Joseph and his brothers and how Joseph's plans could have been thought to be falling apart but ultimately God had bigger plans for Joseph.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Vice Virtues: Despond - When your world falls apart
description: Pastor Daniel concludes the sermon series Vice virtues talking about being despondent and how only Jesus can give you hope in a world full of hurt and chaos,
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Vice Virtues: Vainglory - Glory to God Alone
description: Pastor Daniel teaches from Romans 8 how God alone is worthy of glory, but one day he will give glory to all his children. Vainglory is a vice that tells us to claim our glory now, but the glory pursued in this vice is ultimately empty. Jesus turns our hearts from vainglory to magnanimity by his grace and through his faithfulness.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Vice Virtues: Pride - There is Only One God
description: This week Pastor Daniel continues our sermon series called Vice Virtues. In the Old Testament book of Daniel 4:28-37, we see how God causes the great King Nebuchadnezzar to turn from the vice of pride to the virtue of humility.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Vice Virtues: Envy - Love One Another
description: This week, Pastor Larry teaches about the sin of envy - and the corresponding virtue of love.

title: Vice Virtues: Wrath - God is Our Avenger
description: This week, Pastor Daniel teaches about anger - and the virtues of Jesus.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Vice Virtues: Sloth - Never Give Up
description: Pastor Daniel continues the Vice Virtues sermon series by teaching how Jesus helps us fight our sloth.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Vice Virtues: Gluttony - Choose the Food that Feeds Your Soul
description: This week, John preaches from Philippians about the surprising severity of gluttony.

title: Vice Virtues: Lust, the Enemy of Great Sex
description: This week, Pastor Daniel teaches about the ancient vice, lust - and points us to Jesus, full of virtue.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Vice Virtues: Turning from Vice to Virtues
description: Pastor Daniel begins our new sermon series: Vice Virtues. He teaches how the vices that tend to plague us actually point to Jesus, full of virtue.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Money Talks: Working in a Better Story
description: This week, Pastor Daniel teaches how we do our best work... primarily when it is couched in the story of the Gospel.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Money Talks: Debt is Not the End
description: This week Pastor Larry teaches about debt - and how the Bible applies Jesus' sacrifice to all our lives.

title: Money Talks: Tithing Gives Back to Us
description: This week, Pastor Daniel continues the Money Talks sermon series. He shares from God's word about how we are supposed to think about money and specifically tithing.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Money Talks: I am Satisfied
description: This week, Pastor Daniel explains the foundation of the christian understanding of possessions and where to find satisfaction.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Missionary God: Won't You Be My Neighbor?
description: This week, guest speaker Joey Dodson speaks about loving our enemies.

title: Missionary God: You Are Sent
description: This week's sermon text is Matthew 9:35-38. John shares with the church about how Jesus carries out his mission - and how he calls us to do the same.

title: Missionary God: Live with Intentional Faith
description: This week's sermon text was John 3:16. Pastor Daniel shares how we are to live with intentional faith every day of the week.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Missionary God: Jesus Sends Us Into the World
description: This week's Scripture reading was John 20:19-21. Pastor Daniel shares with us how Jesus sends us into the world to be missionaries - but doesn't ask us to do something he was unwilling to do. Instead, Jesus modeled mission and empowers us for it.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Missionary God: Believe for Life
description: This week, Pastor Larry continues the sermon series called, "Missionary God.' He discusses the gifts we receive when we become Christians.

title: Missionary God: God Moves!
description: This week, Pastor Daniel kicks off the sermon series called "Missionary God," explaining the deepest nature of God.. as a missionary.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Victory: Jesus Guarantees the Love of God
description: Pastor Daniel finishes the Victory sermon series by explaining how Jesus guarantees God's love for us.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Victory: Nothing Can Separate Us From the Love of Christ!
description: Pastor Daniel continues the sermon series on Romans 8 by talking about God's unstoppable love.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Victory: We Have Victory Over Condemnation
description: Daniel continues the sermon series in Romans 8 by discussing how Jesus' sacrifice on the cross awards us unmerited victory over condemnation.

title: Victory: Never Doubt the Generosity of God
description: This week, Pastor Daniel continues our exploration of Romans 8 by discussing the unending generosity of God.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Victory: We Are Chosen to Win
description: In this week's sermon, Pastor Daniel teaches that God chooses to love us and save us despite our weakness.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Victory: With God, Even Bad is Good
description: This week, Pastor Larry teaches from Romans 9 about how God uses even the worst things for our good.

title: Victory: Our Weakness is No Match for God's Strength
description: This week, Pastor Daniel continues the sermon series in Romans 8 by explaining how our weaknesses, even when they are many, are used by God and cannot compare to his strength.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Victory: We Are People of Hope
description: This week, Daniel continues the sermon series from Romans 8 explaining how the people who belong to Jesus are filled with hope - and share it with the world.

title: Victory: Jesus Promises Us the World
description: This week, Pastor Daniel shares how Jesus' victory on the cross results in our inheritance of the world. Rather than relying on our own power to solve all the problems of modern society, we must trust in Jesus - who promises to draw the world to Himself.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Victory: You Belong
description: This week, we focus on how belonging to God is the truest, deepest identity of every Christian.

title: Victory: Follow Jesus and Walk in Truth
description: This week, Daniel shares with us how to walk with Jesus in the truth of his Gospel.

title: Victory: Life Comes Through Death
description: This week, Pastor Daniel discusses how we can find true life by dying to ourselves.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Victory: Life is Found in the Spirit of God
description: This week, pastor Larry shares how God's spirit gives us life.

title: Victory: Outlook Determines Outcome
description: Continuing our sermon series on Romans 8 this week, Pastor Daniel lays out the Biblical idea that we go toward that which we focus on most.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Victory: Never Lose Again
description: Pastor Daniel starts the series on Romans 8 by teaching how Christians have victory in every circumstance.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Christmas Cures Ingratitude
description: This week Pastor Daniel preaches about how the birth of Jesus can destroy our ingratitude.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Jesus is Jealous for Us
description: What was it that motivated the heart of God to come to earth and rescue us? Pastor Daniel reveals the heart of our Lord as he looked upon our helpless condition and his heart was stirred with emotions we are familiar with; Jesus was jealous for us and it moved him to act.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: You are Loved
description: Pastor Larry teaches from John 3:16-17 reminding us that our true identity is found in the love that God has for us. We are loved because of the lasting gift of Jesus's mission on the cross and not because of our actions.

title: Mesmerized: Bless the Lord at All Times
description: Pastor Daniel shares from the Bible about how Jesus blesses even the modern follower and how worshipping Him leads to our joy.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Mesmerized: Listen to Jesus
description: We all have voices that speak loudly into our lives. Family, friends, and bosses speak into our hearts. We also hear from our own voice. Our past regrets, failures, and present struggles team with anxiety about the future. These all shape our beliefs. With voices constantly speaking to you, where does the voice of Jesus fit into your life? What is he saying to you? Pastor Daniel preaches a message on this and encourages us to listen to Jesus.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Mesmerized: See and Believe
description: When we look at Jesus when he raised Lazarus from the dead, we see scenes from the story that empower us to believe. Listen to this sermon and see Jesus calling you out from death to life and from unbelief to belief.

title: Mesmerized: Jesus is Greater Than Our Excuses
description: When Jesus came back to his home town of Nazareth, he was met with crowds who found excuses as to why they didn't believe in him. They knew Jesus since childhood, they knew his family, and they were waiting for the "real" Messiah. Their familiarity with Jesus kept them from believing. We do the same thing today when we think of excuses to not believe. It's a good thing that Jesus is greater than our excuses.

title: Mesmerized: Jesus is More Amazing Than You Know
description: It's easy to forget how amazingly powerful and majestic Jesus is, only focusing on his gentleness and mercy. Pastor Daniel teaches how the gospel demonstrates both sides of Jesus, and Revelation 1:9-20 reveals how these contrasting sides come together.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Mesmerized: Jesus Offers Amnesty to the Doomed
description: It's easy to look upon certain people and think, "They are doomed," and sometimes that judgment can be easily pronounced upon ourselves. The gospel shows us that we are all equally doomed, but then it shows us the good news that God offers life to all those who believe. Pastor Daniel preaches the story of the immoral woman weeping at the feet of Jesus and revealing the compassionate, gracious, and powerful love of Jesus. When we see Jesus as he is, we will be mesmerized by him.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: Mesmerized: When You Feel Like Giving Up
description: At some point in our lives we will feel like giving up on something or someone. In those times our faith in God can give us the strength to endure, but what do you do when it is your faith in God that you're tempted to give up? Pastor Daniel shares how being mesmerized with Christ will rekindle our affection for, and our faith in, God.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: I Believe: Life Everlasting Means Living With God
description: We complete the sermon series on the Apostles' Creed by focusing on the last line of "the life everlasting." Pastor Daniel preaches on how eternal life is more than just going to heaven, eternal life means living with God forever.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: I Believe: Live with Sure and Confident Hope
description: Pastor Daniel continues the section on the Apostles' Creed which states "the resurrection of the body." We learn that we can live with sure and confident hope because Jesus guarantees the bodily resurrection of all who have faith in Him.
speaker: Pastor Daniel

title: I Believe: Forgivness is Freedom
description: Pastor Larry shares with us how there is freedom in forgiveness.

title: I Believe: Sacrifice Individuality for Community
